effectEntries.effect: Fails if not used on a sleeping Pokémon. Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Only works on sleeping Pokémon. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

effectEntries.effect: Échoue si non utilisé sur un Pokémon endormi. Inflige des dégâts réguliers. Draine la moitié des dégâts infligés pour soigner le lanceur.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Ne fonctionne que sur les Pokémon endormis. Draine la moitié des dégâts infligés pour soigner le lanceur.

descriptions.text: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

Steals HP from a sleeping victim.
An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.
Takes one half the damage inflicted on a sleeping foe.
Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.
